text:
Assistant A is more accurate and directly responsive. It correctly identifies the main US and Chinese antitrust laws, explains their basic impact on competition, and provides multiple relevant case studies for both jurisdictions, including Standard Oil, AT&T, Microsoft, infant formula price-fixing, Qualcomm, and Tetra Pak. Assistant B discusses the impact of antitrust laws in more general detail, but its comparison is thinner and its main China case study—the Didi Chuxing investigation—is questionable and not a well-established antitrust enforcement example. Assistant B also makes a less precise claim that China’s Anti-Monopoly Law has been amended “several times.” Overall, Assistant A is more reliable and better fulfills the request.

[[A]]
